data.body: **[P2] Avoid parenting late completions to an already-ended context.** With early-completing map/parallel branches or an unawaited callback, a descendant can finish after its child context. This fallback recreates that context's deterministic parent ID even though its span has already ended, producing a child whose end exceeds its parent's immutable end. Track operation IDs ended during this invocation and fall back to Workflow for those; synthesize the deterministic parent only when it was never traversed in this invocation. Add a same-invocation late-descendant test.
